args.message:
fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) when rounding
to cents. Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that ties
round to the nearest even cent, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` when quantizing to cents, so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g., `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding`.

Closes the nightly build failure.
